sources.note: VA VIC is issued as a digital card emailed to the veteran; no Apple Wallet pass and no barcode mentioned.
Apple Community: the issuer (VA) must enable Add to Apple Wallet; it does not, so no official VIC Wallet pass exists.
Apple Community thread (2026): users confirm no VA-issued Veteran ID Card pass available in Apple Wallet; VA approval still not granted.
Wikipedia Veteran ID Card article re-verified Nov 2026: no Apple Wallet pass; VA still issues VIC as a digital card via email only.
